vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: rush-reskill-usage
Version: 0.1.1

The skill bundle is a legitimate usage guide for 'reskill', a Git-based package manager for AI agent skills. It provides comprehensive instructions for CLI commands, configuration via skills.json, and multi-agent integration (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). While it directs the agent to use a specific default registry (https://rush.zhenguanyu.com/) and recommends installing a CLI tool via npm, these actions are entirely consistent with the stated purpose of the skill and show no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or hidden prompt-injection attacks.
